cards.example: 灌溉工程超过历代的总和。
cards.exampleTranslation: Irrigation projects surpassed all previous dynasties combined.
cards.breakdown: 灌：用水（氵）浇灌 · 溉：用水（氵）冲洗田地

cards.example: 唐朝灌溉工程超过历代的总和。
cards.exampleTranslation: Tang irrigation projects surpassed all previous dynasties combined.

cards.example: 与唐通商的国家有70多个。
cards.exampleTranslation: Over 70 countries traded with the Tang.

cards.example: 唐商业繁荣。
cards.exampleTranslation: Tang commerce was prosperous.

cards.example: 唐允许外国人长期居住。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang permitted foreigners to reside long-term.
cards.breakdown: 允：一个人点头答应 · 许：用言语（讠）表示同意

cards.example: 外国人可以和中国人通婚。
cards.exampleTranslation: Foreigners could intermarry with Chinese people.

cards.example: 唐在世界上很有声望。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang had great prestige in the world.
cards.breakdown: 声：士人敲磬（殳）发出声音 · 望：站在高处（亡）远远地看（月+王）

cards.back: 'Tang people' — what foreigners called Chinese people
cards.example: 各国开始把中国人称为唐人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Countries began to call Chinese people 'Tang people.'

cards.example: 日本的留学生来到长安。
cards.exampleTranslation: Japanese exchange students came to Chang'an.

cards.example: 外国人也可以在中国任官。
cards.exampleTranslation: Foreigners could also hold office in China.

cards.example: 唐积极与各国交往。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang actively interacted with many countries.

cards.example: 交通以长安为中心四通八达。
cards.exampleTranslation: Transport extended in all directions from Chang'an.

cards.back: a superb collection of beautiful things (dazzling variety)
cards.example: 商品琳琅满目。
cards.exampleTranslation: Goods were a dazzling array of beautiful things.
cards.breakdown: 琳琅：美玉（王）碰撞发出悦耳的声音 · 满目：充满眼睛所能看到的

cards.back: standing in great numbers (like a forest)
cards.example: 长安店铺林立。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shops stood in great numbers in Chang'an.
cards.breakdown: 林：两棵树（木木）并排站着，像森林一样密集

cards.example: 城内街道整齐，树木成行。
cards.exampleTranslation: City streets were orderly, with trees in rows.

cards.example: 街道两边有排水沟。
cards.exampleTranslation: There were drainage ditches on both sides of the streets.

cards.example: 创造了灿烂的隋唐文化。
cards.exampleTranslation: They created brilliant Sui-Tang culture.
cards.breakdown: 灿：火（火）光闪耀 · 烂：火（火）烧得彻底，光芒四射

cards.example: 隋唐文化是中国封建文化的高峰。
cards.exampleTranslation: Sui-Tang culture was the peak of Chinese feudal culture.

cards.example: 唐朝是中国诗歌的黄金时代。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang was the golden age of Chinese poetry.

cards.example: 唐朝是诗歌的黄金时代。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang was the golden age of poetry.

cards.example: 汉族吸收了不少外来文化。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Han people absorbed much foreign culture.
cards.breakdown: 吸：用嘴（口）往里吸气 · 收：用手把东西收拢起来

cards.example: 可以欣赏胡人的优美乐舞。
cards.exampleTranslation: One could enjoy the beautiful music and dance of the Hu people.

cards.back: the An Lushan Rebellion (major turning point of Tang decline)
cards.example: 唐朝在安史之乱后走向衰落。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang declined after the An Lushan Rebellion.

cards.example: 唐朝走向衰落。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Tang moved toward decline.
cards.breakdown: 衰：衣服（衣）中间破了，由盛转衰

cards.example: 唐朝末年爆发了黄巢起义。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Huang Chao Uprising erupted at the end of the Tang.

cards.back: the Huang Chao Uprising (late Tang peasant rebellion)
cards.example: 黄巢起义加速了唐朝灭亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Huang Chao Uprising accelerated the Tang's fall.

cards.back: Empress Wu Zetian — China's only female emperor
cards.example: 武则天是中国历史上唯一的女皇帝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Wu Zetian was the only female emperor in Chinese history.

cards.back: Li Bai — famous Tang dynasty poet
cards.example: 著名诗人有李白等。
cards.exampleTranslation: Famous poets included Li Bai and others.

cards.example: 新罗的商人来到长安。
cards.exampleTranslation: Merchants from Silla came to Chang'an.

cards.example: 在波斯人开的酒店里可以欣赏乐舞。
cards.exampleTranslation: In restaurants opened by Persians, one could enjoy music and dance.
